content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Authorize.net ## slug: authorizenet ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) () If you were an Authorize.net customer before coming to Blackthorn | Payments, you may want to sync your customers and Payment Methods from Authorize.net into Salesforce. Please refer the documentation below for instructions to migrate the historic customers and Payment Methods into Salesforce. ::: ## Overview With {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, we support over 20 processors. The list of supported processors is [here](https://developer.authorize.net/api/reference/features/processor_support.html){target="_blank"}. When setting up {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, you can either use {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} as a processor or use any number of their supported processors. [The pricing will vary.](https://www.authorize.net/en-us/sign-up/pricing.html){target="_blank"} ## Scope The {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is currently supported with {{variable.Product_PayLink}}, {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}, and the {{variable.Product_Events}} checkout. ## Instructions If you do not have an {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} account and need one, [please fill out this form](https://account.authorize.net/ui/themes/anet/oauth/PricingPage.aspx?resellerID=106513){target="_blank"}. If you have a contract with one of the supported 20+ processors and want to use {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} as your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}, you'll need an {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} account. Use these account credentials to connect your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} following the setup doc below. :::(Info) (Customer Information Manager) If you've had an Authorize.net account for a while (pre 2018) you'll want to ensure that you've enabled the Customer Information Manager. This will ensure you don't run into unexpected errors later. From your authorize.net account goto Tools > Customer Information Manager > Click "Sign up for Customer Information Manager (CIM) Now". Check out this [article](https://support.paykickstart.com/knowledge-base/authorize-net-error-customer-information-manager-not-enabled/){target="_blank"} for more information and screenshots. ::: ## Setup ### Authorize.net Permission Requirements The user who connects the payment gateway to Authorize.net must have the following permissions checked on their Account Owner Profile. * Permissions Key * Irrevocable permission * Transaction Processing Permissions * Create charge transactions * Create refund transactions * Update unsettled transactions * Manage ARB subscriptions * Manage CIM profiles * Settings Permissions * Edit transaction format settings * Update transaction security settings * Edit basic fraud settings * Edit AFDS settings * Manage mobile devices * Account Level Permissions * Update business information * Manage account services * View account finances * View/download eCheck.Net NOC reports * User Management Permissions * Manage account users ![Authorize.net Required Permissions](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Authorize%20Required%20Permissions.png){height="" width=""} ### Create a Payment Gateway :::(Info) (**Multiple Currencies**) If you are a customer that needs to support multiple currencies through your Authorize.net Payment Gateway you will need to create an Authorize.net gateway for each currency. This is a limitation for Authorize.net. We do have a validation you can enable to make sure your Transaction record currencies match your Payment Gateway currencies. Check it out [here](/v1/docs/custom-settings). ::: To begin, you will need to create a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record to connect to your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} account. It can be done via the [Payment Setup Wizard](/v1/docs/connect-authorizenet-test-mode){target=`_blank`} or the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} tab. #### Using the Blackthorn | Payment Setup Wizard 1. Navigate to Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) app and click the {{variable.Tab_PT_BTPayAdmin}} tab. 2. Set {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} = "Authorize.net". 3. Check "Test" if you want to connect to your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} sandbox. *If you don't have a sandbox account yet, [create a sandbox](https://developer.authorize.net/hello_world/sandbox/) for testing.* 3. Click {{variable.Button_PG_ConnecttoGateway}}. 4. Complete the Payments {{variable.Feature_PaymentsSetupWizard}} flow. ![H_02_01_create payment gateway 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_create%20payment%20gateway%201.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) () Once the Setup Wizard is completed, you'll notice that the `Gateway User Email`, `Gateway Public Key` and `Payment Gateway Account Country` fields are auto-populated. This means that the Payment Gateway is successfully connected. ::: ![H_02_01_create payment gateway 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_create%20payment%20gateway%202.png){height="" width=""} #### Using the App Launcher 1. Navigate to the App Launcher and select Blackthorn | Payments (Admin) app. 2. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s tab and click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Define the {{variable.Field_PG_PaymentGatewayName}}. 4. Set {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} = "Authorize.net". 5. Check "Test" if you want to connect to your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} sandbox.*If you don't have a sandbox account yet, [create a sandbox](https://developer.authorize.net/hello_world/sandbox/) for testing.* 6. Provide a {{variable.Field_PG_WebhookLabel}}, if [{{variable.Task_Webhook}}s](/v1/docs/webhooks) are implemented (Optional). 7. Provide a valid currency code in {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCurrency}}, a blank {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCurrency}} is considered "USD". 8. Check the {{variable.Field_PG_EnableAuthNetCVVFilte}} field if you want to require users to re-enter their CVV code for the card they are using. 9. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![H_02_01_create payment gateway 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_create%20payment%20gateway%203.png){height="" width=""} 9. Once the record is saved, click {{variable.Button_PG_ConnecttoGateway}}. ![H_02_01_create payment gateway 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_create%20payment%20gateway%204.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) () The `Gateway User Email`, `Gateway Public Key` and `Payment Gateway Account Country` will be auto-populated once the gateway is successfully connected. ::: ![H_02_01_create payment gateway 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_create%20payment%20gateway%205.png){height="" width=""} ### Define the Gateway User ID {{snippet.PGSetup_AuthNet_DefineGatewayUserID}} ### Add a Payment Method Follow the instructions below to set up Credit Card and ACH [{{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s](/v1/docs/payment-methods) with {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}. ### Create a Transaction 1. Create a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record (Charge). 2. Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} lookup field to an {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} related record. 3. Enter an {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}. 4. Enter a {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}} (Optional). 5. Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_InvoiceNumbe}} (Optional) - *You will need to add this field to the page layout*. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click {{variable.Button_Capture}} or {{variable.Button_Events_Authorize}}. Refer to the [Charge a Transaction](/v1/docs/transactions#section-captured-transaction) guide for additional information. #### Refund a Transaction {{snippet.PAY_RefundAuthNetTransactions}} Click {{variable.Button_Refund}} to refund a captured {{variable.Object_Transaction}} or to release an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. #### Duplicate Transactions To prevent incorrect duplicate {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s when using {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, a new custom setting labeled “Duplicate window” was added to Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings. The new custom setting includes the following functionality. * The user is UNABLE to capture the duplicate {{variable.Object_Transaction}} when * the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is within the time mentioned in the Duplicate window custom setting * the Duplicate window = “NULL” in Custom Settings * The user is ABLE to capture the duplicate {{variable.Object_Transaction}} when * the time is after the time set in the Duplicate window custom setting * running the Batch Job #### Transaction Errors An error code and message are provided in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorCode}} fields when a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} fails. Review the [response codes](https://developer.authorize.net/api/reference/features/errorandresponsecodes.html) to find specific details about the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorCode}} (Response Codes). *To generate a failed {{variable.Object_Transaction}} for testing, visit* [Authorize.net Testing Guide](https://developer.authorize.net/hello_world/testing_guide/). ### Webhooks Webhooks provide a mechanism where a server-side application (in this case {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}) can notify a client-side application (in this case {{variable.Product_Payments}}) when a new event (like customer create, update, delete, charge capture, charge failed, etc) has occurred on the server. Webhooks automatically send specified data to a destination (endpoint) from database events. Follow our instruction guide [here](/v1/docs/webhooks) for setting up webhooks in {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}. #### Create a Customer in the Authorize.net Portal If you have created a Customer Profile in {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}, {{variable.Task_Webhook}}s can update {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and add the new {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record. **Considerations:** * Payment Profile information will used to populate the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record. * Customer Profile in {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} does not contain many fields. In order to populate the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record, fields from the Payment Profile may be used. * Example: {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} Payment Profile Name = {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} {{variable.Field_PGC_Name}}. ### Visa Checkout (Optional) #### Get the Visa Key from Authorize.net 1. Login in your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} account. 2. Click Account tab > Digital Payment Solutions. 3. Click **Signup** next to "Visa Checkout". 4. Capture the "Visa Key" from the Visa Checkout API Key section. #### Create a Salesforce Site (if not yet created) 1. Register with a site domain in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. Setup > Search for Sites > Sites > Register with a unique Domain > New. 2. Fill in the required information. 3. Set any page to {{variable.Field_SF_ActiveSiteHomePage}} = "True". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 5. Capture the {{variable.Field_SF_URL}} and {{variable.Field_SF_Path}}. Ex. https://myurl-developer-edition.na91.force.com/mypath The client-side HTML will call `start ()` function to `init (payload)`. You have to use the "Visa Key" in the HTML. The same value will be stored in the {{variable.Field_PG_GatewayPublicKey}} field on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. ### Migrate Payment Methods and Customers If you were an {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} customer before coming to Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}}, you may want to sync your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} customers (Customer Profile), {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s (Payment Profiles), and {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s from {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} into {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. This guide will help you understand our object model so you can easily sync the information using the Data Loader tool. 1. Create a [Payment Gateway](/v1/docs/payments-deploy-production-connect-authorizenet-live-mode){target=`_blank`} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and connect to your {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} account. 2. Export customers and cards information from {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} gateway into an excel document. Please convert to CSV type file. 3. We have two objects in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} - [{{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}s](/v1/docs/stripe-customer) and [{{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s](/v1/docs/payment-methods) where this information will be mapped. Prepare an excel spreadsheet with this customer information mapping to respective fields on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}/{{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. 4. In {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}, go to Custom Settings > Blackthorn | Payment Triggers > Edit > Disable all triggers. 5. Contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to disable CVV and Postal Code checks. (If you have information about the postal code, we can skip disabling this for you.) 6. Download the CSV file and import into the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} using the Data Loader. 7. Export the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} list from {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and locate the record ID. Map the record ID in your Excel spreadsheet to {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGatewayCustome}} lookup field on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} before importing. 8. Import the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s into {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. 9. Visit Custom Settings to “Enable all triggers”. #### Customer Field Map | {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} Field Name | {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} Label | | --- | --- | | Payment Gateway Customer | Payment Profile | | Email | Email | | Name | First Name + Last Name | | Customer ID | Customer Profile ID | | Description | Description | | Billing City (Optional) | City | | Company | Company | | Postal Code(optional) | ZipPostal Code | | Billing Street 1 (Optional) | Address | | Billing State (Optional) | StateProvince | | Billing Country | Country | | Phone | Phone | #### Payment Field Map | {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} Field Name | {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} Label | | --- | --- | | Payment Method | Payment Profile | | Holder’s Name | First Name + Last Name | | Email (Optional) | Email | | Card ID | Payment Profile ID | | Customer ID | Customer Profile ID | | Record Type(Card/ACH) | Payment Type (CreditCard/Bank Account) | | Street(Optional) | Address | | City(Optional) | City | | State (Optional) | StateProvince | | Country (Optional) | Country | | Last 4 Digits | CardNumber (last 4 digits) | | Payment Gateway (lookup) | Hardcode the PG id | | Payment Gateway Customer(lookup) | Fetch id from SF | | Payment Method Status | Valid | ### Alternative Migrating Method To link the {{variable.Object_Contact}}s and/or {{variable.Object_Account}}s to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} or {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records, complete the following steps. * Create a report in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} for {{variable.Object_Contact}}s with the {{variable.Field_Contact_FirstName}}, {{variable.Field_Contact_LastName}}, {{variable.Field_Contact_Email}}, and {{variable.Field_Contact_RecordID}} fields. * Export them to a CSV file. * Create and export a report of all {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} records with {{variable.Field_PGC_Name}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}} and {{variable.Field_PGC_RecordID}} fields. * In Sheet B, create a new column "Contact" and add the formula to match the contacts to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} via email. * Download to CSV then import them back into {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} with size 1. * Once the {{variable.Field_PGC_Contact}} lookup is set on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}, it will auto-update the related {{variable.Object_Account}} as well as update all associated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s with the set {{variable.Object_Contact}} and {{variable.Object_Account}}. :::(Info) (**Using a Process Builder**) If you want a Contact record created, you can create a Process Builder to create a Salesforce Contact when the Authorize.net Customer record is created in Salesforce. ::: This sync process is only to migrate your records from that moment backwards. Syncing {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} with {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} going forward can be done through {{variable.Task_Webhook}}s, but you should not be originating records outside of {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. ## Testing data Find the testing information for {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} [here](/v1/docs/test-authorizenet-payment-gateway){target=`_blank`}. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](/v1/docs/payments-error-codes) page. If you still have {{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} questions, please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}}. We're happy to help!
